name: playerMode
label: Player mode
details: Select the layout of the player.

options.label: Minimalistic: Shows a simplified player with the essential playback controls.
Full: Shows the complete audio player, including playback controls, progress and volume controls.
Transparent: The controls are hidden, but a hover effect shows the playback area can be clicked to play the sound.

name: fitToWrapper
label: Fit to wrapper
details: Makes the audio player fill the available width of its container.

name: controls
label: Enable controls
details: Controls allow the user to for instance pause the audio

name: autoplay
label: Enable autoplay
details: With autoplay, the audio starts playing automatically. Autoplay may not be supported by all browsers.

name: audioNotSupported
label: Audio not supported message
default: Your browser does not support this audio
